messages.content: generate a pdf for application of resignation

Creating a PDF for an application of resignation involves several steps. Below is a basic template you can use. Please note that this is a general template and may need to be tailored to your specific company's policies and procedures.

---

**[Your Company Name]**

**Resignation Application**

**Employee Name:** [Your Name]
**Employee ID:** [Your Employee ID]
**Position:** [Your Position]
**Department:** [Your Department]

---

**Date:** [Insert Date]

**To Whom It May Concern:**

I, [Your Name], hereby resign from my position as [Your Position] in the [Your Department] of [Your Company Name]. My resignation takes effect on [Insert Date].

I have been employed with [Your Company Name] since [Insert Start Date] and have worked diligently to contribute to the success of the organization. I am grateful for the opportunities and experiences I have had here.

I understand that my resignation will be effective on [Insert Date] and that I will continue to fulfill my obligations until that date. I will also assist in the transition of my responsibilities to my successor.

I have reviewed and understood the company's policies and procedures regarding resignations and understand that I am responsible for providing any necessary information or assistance to my successor.

I hereby confirm that I have received all necessary approvals for my resignation and that I am fully prepared to leave the company.

I am available for any questions or concerns that may arise during the transition period.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]

---

### Additional Tips:
- **Company Policy:** Ensure that the resignation application aligns with your company's official resignation policy.
- **Legal Requirements:** Check if there are any legal requirements or procedures that need to be followed.
- **Approval Process:** If your company has a formal approval process for resignations, include that information in the application.
- **Signature:** Include a space for your signature and the date of your resignation.

This template can be customized further based on your specific needs and company policies.
